warning: Sanitized historical example. Not installation authority or current inventory.

example.versionPolicy: Apple system OpenSSH follows signed OS updates; Windows existing Git OpenSSH follows its existing owner
example.transport: Windows loopback reverse forwarding through the existing strict windows-host outbound alias
example.authentication: dedicated Windows-generated Ed25519 client key and dedicated Mac-generated host key; no private key transfer
example.dataBoundary: keys, host pins, account names and rendered configurations remain private runtime files outside Git
example.policyScope: An explicit local decision is required to permit only the separate unprivileged loopback SSH daemon; system Remote Login and TCP22 remain off. Existing Tailscale grants, VPN, firewall and other SSH clients remain unchanged.
example.persistence: two owner LaunchAgents restart server and outbound tunnel during the Mac user login session
example.smoke: strict Windows ssh mac command returns a fixed sentinel and Darwin; SFTP roundtrip confined to a disposable owned file
example.removal: stop only owned labels, remove exact managed Mac runtime files and Windows include; retain all keys
example.rollback: same bounded removal; restore unrelated SSH config bytes by removing only the exact leading Include line
